arguments.sql_query:
WITH iso_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 984232
), iso_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_concept_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_exposure_id) AS rn
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN iso_desc i ON i.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), starts AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date
  FROM iso_exposures e
  JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.rn = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), e.drug_exposure_start_date) BETWEEN 12 AND 17
), alt_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id='Measurement'
    AND standard_concept='S'
    AND concept_id IN (3006923, 3027388, 3005755, 46236949, 46235106)
), alt_90 AS (
  SELECT s.person_id, MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number > 2.0 * m.range_high THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_alt_gt_2x_uln,
         COUNT(*) AS alt_tests,
         MAX(m.value_as_number) AS max_alt,
         MAX(m.range_high) AS max_recorded_uln
  FROM starts s
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = s.person_id
  JOIN alt_concepts ac ON ac.concept_id = m.measurement_concept_id
  WHERE m.measurement_date >= s.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 91, s.index_date)
    AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
    AND m.range_high IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.person_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starts) AS adolescent_new_starters,
  COUNT(a.person_id) AS starters_with_alt_and_uln_within_90d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.has_alt_gt_2x_uln = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starters_with_alt_gt_2x_uln,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.has_alt_gt_2x_uln = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starts),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS pct_of_all_new_starters,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.has_alt_gt_2x_uln = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(a.person_id),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS pct_among_those_with_alt_and_uln
FROM alt_90 a;

WITH iso_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 984232
), iso_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_exposure_id) AS rn
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de JOIN iso_desc i ON i.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), starts AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date
  FROM iso_exposures e JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.rn = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), e.drug_exposure_start_date) BETWEEN 12 AND 17
), alt_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (3006923,3027388,3005755,46236949,46235106)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS alt_measurements_90d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS patients_with_alt_90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.range_high IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alt_measurements_with_range_high,
       MIN(m.value_as_number) AS min_alt, MAX(m.value_as_number) AS max_alt,
       MIN(m.range_high) AS min_range_high, MAX(m.range_high) AS max_range_high
FROM starts s
JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id=s.person_id
JOIN alt_concepts ac ON ac.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE m.measurement_date >= s.index_date AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day,91,s.index_date)
  AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL;

WITH iso_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 984232
), iso_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_exposure_id) AS rn
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de JOIN iso_desc i ON i.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), starts AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, e.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date
  FROM iso_exposures e JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.rn = 1
    AND DATEDIFF(year, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1)), e.drug_exposure_start_date) BETWEEN 12 AND 17
)
SELECT TOP 30 m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, m.measurement_source_value, m.unit_source_value,
       COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT m.person_id) AS patients,
       SUM(CASE WHEN m.range_high IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_range_high,
       MIN(m.value_as_number) AS min_value, MAX(m.value_as_number) AS max_value
FROM starts s
JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id=s.person_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id
WHERE m.measurement_date >= s.index_date AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day,91,s.index_date)
  AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
  AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%' OR LOWER(m.measurement_source_value) LIKE '%alt%')
GROUP BY m.measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, m.measurement_source_value, m.unit_source_value
ORDER BY n DESC;
SELECT TOP 50 * FROM omop.concept_numeric WHERE concept_id IN (3006923,3027388,3005755,46236949,46235106);

    AND DATEADD(year, 12, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth,1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth,1))) <= e.drug_exposure_start_date

), alt_90 AS (
  SELECT s.person_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number > 80.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_alt_gt_80,
         COUNT(*) AS alt_tests,
         MAX(m.value_as_number) AS max_alt
  FROM starts s
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = s.person_id
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3006923,3027388,3005755,46236949,46235106)
    AND m.measurement_date >= s.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 91, s.index_date)
    AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL

  SUM(CASE WHEN a.has_alt_gt_80 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS starters_with_alt_gt_80_assuming_uln_40,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.has_alt_gt_80 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM starts),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS pct_of_all_new_starters,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.has_alt_gt_80 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(a.person_id),0) AS decimal(10,2)) AS pct_among_those_with_alt
FROM alt_90 a;

content.text:
Using the OMOP EHR data:

- **Cohort:** adolescents age 12–17 at first recorded isotretinoin exposure
- **N:** 1,524 new starters
- **ALT measured within 90 days:** 726 patients
- **ALT > 2× ULN:** 7 patients, using **ALT > 80 U/L** as a proxy for 2× ULN assuming ULN = 40 U/L

So the frequency was:

- **7 / 1,524 = 0.46%** of all adolescent new isotretinoin starters
- **7 / 726 = 0.96%** among those with ALT checked within 90 days

Caveat: the `measurement.range_high` field was not populated for these ALT records, so I could not use patient/test-specific recorded ULNs; I used the common clinical proxy of ULN 40 U/L.
